    wheel_r = p.wheel_od / 2.0
    pocket_r = (p.bearing_od + p.bearing_fit_clearance) / 2.0

    w = p.wheel_width
    bw = p.bearing_width

    gd = p.groove_depth
    gw = p.groove_width

    # Build the axisymmetric wheel directly by revolving its cross-section

        cq.Workplane("XZ")
        .moveTo(shoulder_bore_r, bw)
        .lineTo(pocket_r, bw)
        .lineTo(pocket_r, 0.0)
        .lineTo(wheel_r - c, 0.0)
        .lineTo(wheel_r, c)
        .lineTo(wheel_r, z_mid - gw / 2.0)
        .threePointArc((wheel_r - gd, z_mid), (wheel_r, z_mid + gw / 2.0))
        .lineTo(wheel_r, w - c)
        .lineTo(wheel_r - c, w)
        .lineTo(pocket_r, w)
        .lineTo(pocket_r, w - bw)
        .lineTo(shoulder_bore_r, w - bw)
        .lineTo(shoulder_bore_r, bw)
        .close()
    )
    wheel = profile.revolve(360, (0, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0))
    return wheel
